lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Highly organized grid of circular high-luminance maxima arranged in at least four distinct horizontal rows spanning from the posterior gill slits to the caudal peduncle, with decreasing spot diameter towards the posterior region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal spot rows, most prominent in the mid-flank region, creating a discernible lattice structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges running parallel to the dorsal midline, defined by sharp light-to-dark vertical gradients, extending from the cranial region toward the tail.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, circular high-intensity spots primarily located on the anterior half of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large semi-circular indentation on the posterior-superior margin of the first dorsal fin; smaller irregular notches on the trailing edge of the pectoral fin; presence of small, white irregular lesions/scars near the fifth gill slit.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal organisms (remoras) attached to the ventral surface and trailing near the pectoral fin.
